title: Successful LTE Attach-Detach Procedure with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
description: Validate that a single UE can successfully perform LTE attach and detach procedures 10 consecutive times under excellent radio conditions, achieving 100% success rate.
preconditions: Test setup configured as isolated single cell with no inter-cell interference.
UE placed at cell center with LTE RSRP level within excellent radio condition thresholds.
All other cells powered off.
End-to-end LTE setup operational with no connectivity issues.
testSteps: Configure test parameters as per test configuration and record in test report.
Start logs to capture call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE and wait for LTE attach procedure to complete successfully.
Verify UE is attached to correct cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, and ARFCN in UE logs or application.
Power OFF the UE and wait for LTE detach procedure to complete successfully.
Repeat attach and detach steps for a total of 10 iterations.
Stop and save test logs.
expectedResults: Attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Attach latency measured and recorded with valid minimum, average, and maximum values.
Signalling message flows confirm successful attach and detach per 3GPP TS 23.401 clauses.
Logs confirm UE attached to correct LTE cell parameters.
postconditions: UE remains detached after test completion.
Test logs saved for KPI analysis.
commandsUsed: Generic actions for starting/stopping UE power
verificationMethods: Review signalling message flows in logs
Check KPI tables for success rates and latency
Validate UE cell parameters from logs

Power OFF the UE and wait for 5G NSA detach procedure to complete successfully, including EN-DC Secondary Node Release.
Repeat attach and detach steps for a total of 10 iterations.
Stop and save test logs.
expectedResults: 5G NSA attach success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Secondary Node Addition success rate is 100% over 10 iterations.
Detach success rate (including Secondary Node Release) is 100% over 10 iterations.
Attach latency measured and recorded with valid minimum, average, and maximum values.
Signalling message flows confirm successful attach, Secondary Node Addition, detach, and Secondary Node Release per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340 clauses.
Logs confirm UE attached to correct LTE and 5G cell parameters.
postconditions: UE remains detached after test completion.
Test logs saved for KPI analysis.
commandsUsed: Generic actions for starting/stopping UE power
verificationMethods: Review signalling message flows in logs
Check KPI tables for success rates and latency
Validate UE LTE and 5G cell parameters from logs

expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to inadequate radio conditions.

title: Reject Secondary Node Release Request by Secondary Node
description: Verify that the Secondary Node (SN) can reject a Secondary Node Release request from Master Node (MN) and that the system handles this rejection correctly.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup operational with MN and SN connected.
SN configured to reject release request (simulate SN triggered SN change).
testSteps: MN sends SgNB Release Request to SN to initiate secondary node release.
SN rejects the request by not sending SgNB Release Request Acknowledge or sending reject indication.
Monitor signalling between MN and SN.
Observe MN behavior upon rejection.
Verify UE signaling for any RRC reconfiguration or failure.
Save logs.
expectedResults: SN rejection of release request is properly handled by MN.
MN does not proceed with release and maintains SN connection.
UE does not release SCG configuration prematurely.
No unexpected protocol errors occur.
Logs document rejection and subsequent handling.
verificationMethods: Review signalling flows for reject message
Check UE RRC configuration status
Confirm MN behavior upon rejection
